title: In vivo and in silico evaluation of the phytoalexin-eliciting activity in common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris L.) of jasmonoyl-L-isoleucine analogs having a pyrazolidin-3-one ring
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39325-39336
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06461E, Paper
Open Access

Samuel Vizcaíno Páez, Diego Durango, Wiston Quiñones
Pyrazolidin-3-one analogs of jasmonoyl-L-isoleucine elicit phytoalexin production in Phaseolus vulgaris, and its protein model built by homology shows coherent protein–ligand interactions in the docking approach.
